text:
Nina: New POC ask from 'BlueCrest Health' — 14-day trial to prove convo routing + automated case summary for EU-only customers. They want clear SLOs, security constraints (customer KMS + VPC), and a rough burn estimate.
Owen: What throughput are they expecting? steady vs peak matters for Dedicated sizing.
Nina: Steady ~70 reqs/min, peaks ~210 reqs/min. Avg convo ~580 tokens. Targets: routing p95 <=400ms, summary p95 <=800ms.
Priya: Security checklist: EU-only residency, customer-managed KMS, SIEM forwarding, SOC2. Can POC sit in their VPC? @infra-bot
infra-bot: Dedicated eu-west-1 slot available. Reserve window pending.
Nina: Draft acceptance gates: routing accuracy >=92% on 500 labeled chats; summaries: human-agreement >=85% on 200 samples OR ROUGE-L >=0.62; latency as above; cost target <= $0.016 per 1k input tokens; reliability: fallback to quantized distill if latency>900ms or error rate>1% for 5m.
Owen: Sample eval prompt to share: 
"You are a concise summarizer. Given the conversation, return JSON: {summary, action_items, severity}"
Priya: Confirm no persistent storage of PII unless opted in; transient sessions, KV cache disabled, all blobs encrypted using customer KMS; redaction pipeline available.
Nina: Quick burn calc: ~8.1M tokens/day (14k conv/day *580) -> at $0.016/1k = ~$129.6/day -> ~$1.8k for 14d + infra. Quantized model could save ~25% on compute.
Owen: I'll draft runbook and model config snippet, Priya will own security Q responses, Nina will own SOW signoff.
Nina: Next step: confirm thresholds with customer by EOD, then approve Dedicated reservation. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
